• If the first component is an even number, and the last component is an odd number, then the first and the last components should be coded with the code of K.
 
• If both the second and third components are even numbers, then the codes of these two should be interchanged.
 
• If the first component is a number, and the last component is a symbol, then the code of the number should be used for the symbol as well.

Question:**
